# Roman Mednitzer

> Public profile of Roman Mednitzer, a systems and platform engineer in Vienna who approaches infrastructure as one connected system: capability, state, authority, observability, recovery, and exit paths.

Canonical profile: https://rmednitzer.github.io/
Last reviewed: 2026-10-05.

The website deliberately features `relay-shell`, `infra`, and `automation` because they are the mature public repositories that best represent Roman's systems and platform engineering work. Their selection is about representative value and maturity, not repository recency.

Employment entries on the profile are historical unless explicitly marked current. The site does not state a current employer. The home lab changes frequently, so architectural descriptions are more reliable than inferred host counts, topology, versions, or dataset sizes.

## Profile

- [Markdown profile](https://rmednitzer.github.io/index.md): Clean text representation of the public profile for agents and text-only clients.
- [Structured public profile](https://rmednitzer.github.io/profile.json): Dated JSON representation of stable public facts and interpretation boundaries.
- [Canonical HTML profile](https://rmednitzer.github.io/): Human-facing profile with Schema.org ProfilePage JSON-LD.

## Featured public work

- [relay-shell README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rmednitzer/relay-shell/main/README.md): Governed MCP execution for local shell and SSH fleet operations with authority tiers, policy controls, resource bounds, and audit records.
- [infra README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rmednitzer/infra/main/README.md): OpenTofu infrastructure-as-code for KVM/libvirt and Talos Linux Kubernetes, with CI and architecture decisions.
- [automation README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rmednitzer/automation/main/README.md): Ansible configuration management and hardening aligned with operational and regulatory controls.
